subject: Weighted multilevel path model with binary outcome

messages.author: a4d26fefcb20572e
messages.subject: Weighted multilevel path model with binary outcome
parts:
Hi, 

I am looking for an R package that supports
- path analyses
- binary outcomes,
- multilevel data (students within classes),
- and precision weights. 

I believe Lavaan is not yet supporting these kind of analyses. I was wondering if anyone can suggest me which package (or if necessary, which program) to use?

Thanks a lot in advance, 

Best, 

Machteld

The last feature (precision weights) is the bottleneck. I don't think
any open-source program can do the full combination of the four (yet).

If you have access to Stata, you can use gllamm (http://gllamm.org). An
other option is the commercial program Mplus.

Yves.
